chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 367 – Li Huowang Faces the Soul-Crushing Cost of His Own Power
chapter_meta_description: After escaping the Heart-Turbid trap, Li Huowang earns the Chief Recorder's debt—but a carriage confrontation with Bai Lingmiao cuts deeper than any cosmic horror.
og_title: The Carriage Ride That Will Shatter You
og_description: Li Huowang survives the Heart-Turbid, but Bai Lingmiao's raw, possessive rage in the carriage scene is the true emotional climax.
twitter_title: Li Huowang earns a favor from the Chief Recorder, then learns the hardest lesson: surviving isn't the same as living.
twitter_description: After the sky-hiding horror, a carriage ride forces Li Huowang to confront a different kind of monster—the person who refuses to let him die.

lore_anchors.definition: A corrupt, suffering-based method of transcendence; witnessing it alive and functional shifts the Chief Recorder's attitude from cold distance to fearful respect.
The Heart-Turbid's ability to physically overlay or displace a portion of the heavens, creating a false sky that traps victims beneath it; not an illusion but ontological camouflage.
A face-covering made of threaded old Chinese coins; in the Dao-Twisted World, it provides concealment from supernatural perception, making it a high-value artifact.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the Chief Recorder's attitude change so dramatically toward Li Huowang?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He witnessed Li Huowang emerge alive and functional from the Dung-Beetle Ascension, a suffering-based path that should have left him broken or dead. To a bureaucratic supernatural official, seeing someone survive that process is like watching a corpse crawl out of a swamp—it inspires fearful respect.
A containment paradox where a dead Heart-Turbid entity is used to hide a living one, creating a fabricated layer of reality that victims cannot perceive or escape from.
